title: fix(plugin-view): the registered object-view reads a named view's grid members (objectui#10885)
body:
Part of #10885
Clause-②: no

Member 1 of objectui#10885: route 2, the registered `object-view` renderer's own grid path, reads a named grid view's grid members off the named view. Member 2 is not taken and member 3 is not in this PR (see Acceptance notes), so #10885 remains open.

Claim `5865109811`, seat `domain:ui#2`, PM session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), mode `subagent`.

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`**, the `gridSchema` memo: the `object-grid` node `ObjectView` hands `ObjectGrid` when no host passes `renderListView`.
  - Ten members are read off the active named view first. `pagination` and `selection` then fall back to the node's `table`, as they did before. `rowHeight`, `resizable`, `searchableFields`, `conditionalFormatting`, `rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `bulkActionDefs` and `exportOptions` are named-view sourced, like `grouping` / `rowColor` beside them. There is no `activeView` rung and no new node read.
  - A named view's `hiddenFields` is subtracted from the resolved column projection, in both the `fields` and the `columns` slot (new helper `withoutHiddenFields`). It is not relayed as a key: `object-grid` does not declare it, and `ObjectGrid` has no read of it.
  - A named view's `exportOptions` written in the protocol's legacy bare-array spelling is lifted to `{ formats }` (new helper `gridExportOptions`). That is the lift the protocol's own parse makes, and the one `ListView` makes for the delegation. `ObjectGrid` reads `exportOptions.formats`.
  - `conditionalFormatting` and `bulkActionDefs` carry a type assertion to the grid's declared element type. The protocol's expression wire is wider than that type (measured by `tsc`), and `ObjectGrid` hands both to the shared evaluator, which reads the wire.
- **The objectui#5097 HOST-COMPOSITION fence (the delegation) is byte-identical.** The text between the two `#region` markers hashes to `40bc2292` on the base and on the head.
- **Docs** (the docs-driven rule of AGENTS.md section 5): one prose paragraph each in `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, beside the objectui#10758 paragraph. Neither gains a code fence.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/10885-object-view-route2-named-grid.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch`, with the claim's `Clause-②: no` line. `@object-ui/app-shell` gains only a test file, so it is not listed; `check-changeset-presence` passes.
- **No shared helper.** The order allowed one helper for both routes only if the delegation's behaviour and pins stay untouched. `objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` section 1b derives the fence's named-view read set by name from the fence text, and walks the rungs of the `renderListView` literal. Moving the reads out of the fence changes both derivations, so those pins would have to be edited. The two sinks also differ: `ListView` subtracts `hiddenFields` and lifts `exportOptions` itself, and `ObjectGrid` does neither. So the two routes share the precedence, not the code.

## H1: reproduced on `main` (`733fd5ac65`)

Read from the DOM through the real stack: the real `ViewPreview`, the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, the registered `object-view` renderer and the real `ObjectGrid`. The pin file `ViewPreview.routeTwoGridMembers-10885.test.tsx` was run on an untouched base tree.

- A stored grid view `{ type: 'grid', columns: ['name', 'amount', 'stage'], hiddenFields: ['amount'] }` still draws the hidden column. The header span reading `Budget Amount` is rendered (`expected SPAN to be null`).
- The same view with `rowHeight: 'compact'` draws no row-height control: `Unable to find an element with the title: Row height: compact.`
- **Lit control, green on the base:** `columns: ['name', 'stage']` off the same named view IS honoured on route 2. `Pipeline Stage` is drawn and `Record Owner`, which is not projected, is not.

## Members, per route

The measured set is bucket ① of the objectui#7924 ruling, all 23 members. Route 2 takes a member when three things hold: the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 declares it under the same name on a named view (`ObjectListViewSchema`) and on `object-grid` (`ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']`), and `ObjectGrid` reads it. The pin re-derives both declarations.

| member | delegation (route 3, unchanged) | route 2 before | route 2 after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pagination` | named, host, node | `table.pagination` | named, then `table.pagination` |
| `selection` | named, host, node | `table.selection` | named, then `table.selection` |
| `rowHeight` | named, host (through the fold) | none | named |
| `resizable` | named, host, node | none | named |
| `searchableFields` | named, host, node | none | named |
| `conditionalFormatting` | named, host, node | none | named |
| `rowActions` | named, host, node | none | named |
| `bulkActions` | named, host, node | none | named |
| `bulkActionDefs` | named, host | none | named |
| `exportOptions` | named, host | none | named (a bare array lifted to `{ formats }`) |
| `hiddenFields` | named, host, node | none | named, subtracted from the projection (not relayed) |
| `navigation` | named, host, node | none | none: excluded (Acceptance notes) |
| `inlineEdit` | named, host, node | none | none: excluded (Acceptance notes) |
| `description` | named, host | none | none: `object-grid` does not declare it |
| `emptyState` | named, host, node | none | none: `object-grid` does not declare it |
| `addRecord`, `allowPrinting`, `aria`, `compactToolbar`, `filterableFields`, `sharing`, `showRecordCount`, `userFilters` | named, host, node | none | none: list chrome with no `object-grid` slot |

Route 2's named-view reads on the grid node go from 5 (`columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `grouping`, `rowColor`) to 16.

## Pins and ablation

Red on the base `733fd5ac65` (the two new files copied onto an untouched base worktree), green on the head `56ad7e8774`.

- **`packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.routeTwoNamedGridMembers-10885.test.tsx`**, 11 tests. It mounts through `SchemaRenderer` and the registered renderer, with `ObjectGrid` mocked as the sink.
  - Member set, 3 tests, green on both trees: each relayed member is declared on both protocol schemas; `hiddenFields` is declared on the named view and not on `object-grid`; the full fixture parses under the strict `ObjectListViewSchema`. The control is `allowExport`, which is on neither.
  - THE FIX, red on the base: `pagination did not arrive from the named view: expected { pageSize: 100 } to deeply equal { pageSize: 5, …(1) }`. The bare-array `exportOptions` lift is also red on the base.
  - The node control is green on both: `table.pagination` and `table.selection` apply when the named view omits them, and the other eight stay undefined although the node's `table` carries them.
  - `hiddenFields`, 5 tests. Four are red on the base: both slots lose the hidden field and no `hiddenFields` key reaches the grid; an object-shaped column keeps its shape; the node's `table.columns` is narrowed too; hiding every projected field keeps `[]`. One is green on both: with no projection anywhere, nothing is invented.
- **`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ViewPreview.routeTwoGridMembers-10885.test.tsx`**, 4 tests, the whole real stack with DOM readings. `hiddenFields` and `rowHeight` are red on the base. The lit `columns` control and the neither-declared control are green on both.
- **Base: 8 failed, 7 passed (15). Head: 15 passed.**
- The delegation's objectui#10884 pins (`ObjectView.namedViewProtocolKeys-8980.test.tsx`, `objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx`) are untouched and green.

**Ablation**, run with `ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head `695a6ce635` (the later `56ad7e8774` changes one test-header comment only). The directions were predicted before the run.

- Leg A put the base's two `table` rungs back in place of the ten member rungs: anchor 1 → 0, blob `dcce880456e3` → `57515b34b699`.
- Leg B neutralised the `hiddenFields` read: anchor 1 → 0, blob → `a01a7bdbbcf4`.
- On disk, the named `rowHeight` reads went 2 → 1 (the fence's own stays) and the `gridExportOptions` call 1 → 0.
- The run covered the whole `packages/plugin-view/` suite, both ViewPreview pin files and three types census files. **Result: 8 failed, 789 passed, 59 files.** The 8 are exactly the new rows.
- The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD (`dcce880456e3`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Consumer sweep

`git grep` over test files for `'object-view'`, `ObjectView` mounts and imports, `ViewPreview`, and the tests that read plugin-view's `ObjectView.tsx`, plus the objectui#7924 / objectui#7779 census tests. Everything ran on the head under the verify lock.

- **Batch A: 75 files, 1882 tests passed**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, at `695a6ce635`. It covers the whole `packages/plugin-view/` suite and the ten `packages/types` tests that read named views or the object-view docs. The census `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`, `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923` and `object-view-listviews-by-reference-7928` are among those ten. The rest are from plugin-map, plugin-list, plugin-grid, core, react, examples and `scripts`.
- **Batch B: 38 files, 350 tests passed**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, at `695a6ce635`. It covers app-shell's `ViewPreview`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `ResourceEditPage` and `AppContent` tests, the `ObjectView.*` tests (the relay census `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559` among them), and five `apps/console` tests.
- **The 18 tests that read the changed markdown** (from `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list`): 829 tests passed.
- **Census: no number moved.** The census counts a member as read when any route reads it off a named view. Every member route 2 now reads was already read by the delegation, so the partition stays 43 read / 21 unread of 64, with bucket ① empty. No census test was edited.

## Serial

- PR objectui#10914 (head `2b3d2061a2`) edits `ObjectView.tsx` in one comment of the view-switcher icon map. This PR's hunks are the column helpers and `gridSchema`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against its head is clean (tree `4a03a230b6`). Against a fresh `origin/main` (`733fd5ac65`) it is clean too (tree `749f02ef74`).
- `ViewPreview.tsx` is not edited (PR objectui#10906). The pin is a new file.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is not edited (PR objectui#10278).

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise correction for member 1.** The card says `ObjectGrid` reads each of the eight members. Measured: it reads seven. It has no `hiddenFields` read, and `object-grid` does not declare the key.
  - `hiddenFields` is therefore honoured the way the protocol composes it (objectstack#15184 ruling B: `columns` projects, `hiddenFields` subtracts). It is subtracted from a declared projection, as `ListView` does for the delegation.
  - With no `columns` anywhere, the grid derives its own columns and the hidden field still shows. `ListView` has the same limit.
- **The full set beyond the eight.** `searchableFields`, `bulkActionDefs` and `exportOptions` are also taken: each is declared on both schemas and read by `ObjectGrid`.
- **`navigation` is excluded.** It is declared on both schemas, but `ObjectView` passes `ObjectGrid` its own `onRowClick`, and `useNavigationOverlay` obeys an `onRowClick` first. Relayed, the member would be read by nothing.
  - Route 2's row click is owned by `ObjectView`'s `navigationConfig`, which reads the node's `navigation`.
  - Making it read the named view would also move the delegation's click path, because the delegation hands `ListView` the same `handleRowClick`. That is outside this rung.
- **`inlineEdit` is excluded.** `ObjectGrid` reads `editable`, not `inlineEdit`. `ListView` translates one into the other under its objectui#4647 grant gate. That is a key translation with a permission contract, a new host path, not the named-view-first rung.
- **`fieldOrder` and `label`, which are not in bucket ①.** The delegation reads both off a named view, and route 2 reads neither.
  - `fieldOrder` is the composition's third key, so route 2 does not apply a named view's order.
  - `ObjectGrid` reads `label` for its caption and export filename, while route 2 passes `table.title`.
  - Noted, not filed.
- **Member 2 is not taken.** The delegation does not relay a named view's eight view-kind blocks.
  - The rung this PR adds is on route 2. Covering member 2 would add named-view reads inside the objectui#5097 fence.
  - That moves the delegation's behaviour and its pinned named-view read set (`objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` section 1b), and this order keeps both untouched.
  - Reach is unchanged: no in-tree host passes both `listViews` and `renderListView`.
- **Member 3 is not in this PR.** The three census changesets are untouched, and #10885 remains open for its own prose-only PR. This change moves no census figure: 43 read / 21 unread of 64, with bucket ① empty.
- **Type narrowness, noted.** The protocol's `object-grid` accepts a `conditionalFormatting` rule whose `condition` is the `{ dialect, source }` expression wire. It also accepts a `bulkActionDefs` `visible` wire with `ast` and no `source`. `ObjectGridSchema` in `@object-ui/types` spells neither. The runtime reads both through the shared evaluator. The two rungs assert the declared type; not filed.
- **An observation, not filed.** The protocol's `object-grid` also accepts `exportOptions` as a bare format array, and keeps it an array at parse. `ObjectGrid` reads only `exportOptions.formats`. This is a source reading, not a measured render. Carrier: PR objectui#10278, which holds `ObjectGrid.tsx`.
- **Beyond the claimed file surface:** the README and docs paragraphs (the docs-driven rule of AGENTS.md section 5), and the app-shell pin file (the order's `ViewPreview` pin).
